verdict.rationale: SigNoz publishes its source on GitHub as free open-source software that can be self-hosted, and its docs describe it as an open-source observability platform. A community comment notes that code under the 'ee/' directory carries a separate license, making it open-core; this is a caveat, not a contradiction of the open core. Missing for 10: the specific open license is not named in the evidence, the scope and terms of the ee/ license are unclear, and there is no first-party licensing documentation.
